evals.name: root-single-match
evals.prompt: Use the Atlas Grid GTM context at the root node. Segment Riverbend Electric Cooperative using only these supplied facts: it is an electric utility cooperative with 640 employees; it is modernizing grid operations; its buying team owns outage response and field dispatch. Do not enrich the account.
evals.expected_output: A compact root-node classification to regional-utilities, grounded in visible ICP prose and distinguished from the losing industrial alternative.
expectations: States the Atlas Grid context line with two visible ICPs.
Assigns exactly one bare root label, regional-utilities.
Cites matching language from the regional-utilities ICP and names industrial-energy-operators as a losing alternative.
Uses the required compact result fields and calibrated values.
Does not enrich, ask a question, or change durable state.
Closes with the exact no-side-effects sentence.

evals.name: suborg-bulk-node-local
evals.prompt: Use the Enterprise node in the Northstar Cloud GTM context. Segment these accounts from supplied facts only: (1) Meridian Bank, a regulated bank with 8,200 employees, a cloud platform team, and a mandatory third-party security review; (2) Harbor Mutual, a national insurer with 3,400 employees modernizing claims infrastructure; (3) Sunbeam Solar, a 45-person residential solar installer with no regulated-data workload. Do not enrich them.
evals.expected_output: A three-account bulk result using only Enterprise-local ICPs, with two qualified Enterprise labels and one no-match.
expectations: States the Northstar Enterprise context line with two visible ICPs.
Assigns enterprise/regulated-financial-platforms, enterprise/national-insurers, and no-match exactly once each.
Opens with accurate label, low-confidence, and review-needed counts.
Cites Enterprise ICP language, names plausible losing alternatives, and honors the residential-installer disqualifier.
Never reads or mentions root-only ICP content.
Uses every compact item field, asks no question, and closes with the exact no-side-effects sentence.
Leaves the context repo and Git history unchanged.

evals.name: root-target-reverse-visibility
evals.prompt: Use the root node of the Northstar Cloud GTM context. Segment Patchbay, a 72-person developer-tools company with product-led adoption and an engineering-owned cloud stack. Use supplied facts only and do not enrich it.
evals.expected_output: A root classification to developer-tools-startups that excludes all Enterprise-local ICP prose.
expectations: States the Northstar Cloud root context line with one visible ICP.
Assigns the bare label developer-tools-startups.
Cites root ICP prose without naming or using either Enterprise ICP.
Uses the required compact fields with no question.
Leaves all durable state unchanged and closes with the exact no-side-effects sentence.

evals.name: obvious-suborg-node
evals.prompt: In the Arbor Transit GTM context, segment MetroLink Authority from supplied facts only: it is a public transit agency operating bus and light rail, with 2,100 employees and a network-planning modernization program. No organization node is specified. Do not enrich it.
evals.expected_output: Automatic selection of the only node carrying ICPs and a qualified mobility/public-transit-agencies result without a node question.
expectations: Selects Arbor Mobility as the obvious node without asking.
States one visible ICP and assigns mobility/public-transit-agencies.
Grounds the result in the local ICP prose and explains that no other visible alternative exists.
Uses the required compact fields and exact no-side-effects close.
Leaves all durable state unchanged.

evals.name: empty-visible-set
evals.prompt: Use the root node of the Empty Harbor GTM context. Segment Lakeside Components, a 300-person component manufacturer. Use only supplied facts and do not enrich it.
evals.expected_output: A plain missing-prerequisite stop because the explicitly targeted root has no visible ICPs, even though a suborg owns one.
expectations: States the Empty Harbor root context line with zero visible ICPs.
Reports the missing ICP prerequisite and stops without classifying the account.
Does not inspect, mention, or borrow the suborg-only ICP.
Asks no question and invents no ICP or segment label.
Leaves all durable state unchanged and closes with the exact no-side-effects sentence.
